<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vijayakumar | Video Editor Portfolio Demo</title>
<meta name="description" content="Vijayakumar, freelance video editor specializing in creative editing, color grading and visual storytelling.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0B0B12;
    --card: #12121C;
    --violet: #7C3AED;
    --glow: #A855F7;
    --accent: #C084FC;
    --cyan: #22D3EE;
    --orange: #F59E0B;
    --red: #F43F5E;
    --green: #25D366;
    --text: #F8FAFC;
    --muted: #A1A1AA;
    --border: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.14);
    --radius: 18px;
    --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 90px; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Inter', sans-serif; line-height: 1.15; }

  .ambient {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 30%), rgba(168,85,247,.16), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(500px circle at 90% 90%, rgba(34,211,238,.08), transparent 60%);
    transition: background .2s;
  }

  .container { width: min(1140px, 92%); margin: 0 auto; }
  section { padding: 110px 0; position: relative; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-block; font-size: .8rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 14px; font-weight: 600;
  }
  .section-title { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3rem); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .lead { color: var(--muted); max-width: 640px; font-size: 1.05rem; }

  /* Navigation */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    padding: 18px 0; transition: background .3s, backdrop-filter .3s, padding .3s;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 18px);
  }
  nav.scrolled {
    background: rgba(11,11,18,.82);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding-top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 12px);
    padding-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .nav-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
  .logo { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: .02em; }
  .logo span { color: var(--glow); }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 32px; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: .92rem; color: var(--muted); transition: color .2s; position: relative; }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a.active { color: var(--text); }
  .nav-links a::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -6px; width: 0; height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--violet), var(--cyan)); transition: width .3s var(--ease);
  }
  .nav-links a:hover::after, .nav-links a.active::after { width: 100%; }
  .menu-btn {
    display: none; background: none; border: 0; width: 34px; height: 34px; cursor: pointer; position: relative;
  }
  .menu-btn span {
    position: absolute; left: 6px; right: 6px; height: 2px; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; transition: .3s var(--ease);
  }
  .menu-btn span:nth-child(1) { top: 11px; }
  .menu-btn span:nth-child(2) { top: 21px; }
  .menu-btn.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(5px) rotate(45deg); }
  .menu-btn.open span:nth-child(2) { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(-45deg); }

  /* Buttons */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .25s var(--ease), box-shadow .25s, background .25s, border-color .25s; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .btn:disabled { opacity: .7; cursor: wait; transform: none; }
  .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), var(--glow)); color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(124,58,237,.7);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(168,85,247,.8); }
  .btn-ghost { border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text); background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-3px); }
  .btn-wa { background: var(--green); color: #04150b; }
  .btn-wa:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

  /* Hero */
  .hero { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-top: 120px; }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6.5vw, 5rem); margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .gradient-text {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--glow), var(--cyan), var(--orange));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    background-size: 300% 100%; animation: shimmer 8s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes shimmer { to { background-position: 300% 0; } }
  .role { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .tagline { font-size: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .skills-line { color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .04em; margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .cta { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .exp-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 34px; padding: 10px 18px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(18,18,28,.6); font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .exp-badge b { color: var(--text); }
  .pulse { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,.6); animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse { 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,211,238,0); } }

  .hero-visual { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; }
  .portrait-wrap {
    position: relative; width: min(420px, 90%); aspect-ratio: 3/4; border-radius: 28px;
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); overflow: hidden;
    transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(var(--ry, 0deg)) rotateX(var(--rx, 0deg));
    transition: transform .2s var(--ease);
  }
  .portrait-wrap::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 28px; padding: 2px; z-index: 2;
    background: linear-gradient(140deg, var(--violet), var(--cyan), var(--orange), var(--red));
    -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
    -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; opacity: .7;
  }
  .portrait-wrap img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; }
  .float-chip {
    position: absolute; z-index: 3; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 14px; font-size: .85rem;
    background: rgba(18,18,28,.85); border: 1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .chip-1 { top: 12%; left: -6%; }
  .chip-2 { bottom: 14%; right: -6%; animation-delay: -3s; }
  @keyframes float { 50% { transform: translateY(-12px); } }

  .scroll-cue {
    position: absolute; bottom: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: .75rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .scroll-cue::after {
    content: ""; display: block; width: 1px; height: 40px; margin: 10px auto 0;
    background: linear-gradient(var(--accent), transparent); animation: drip 2s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes drip { 0% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top; } 50% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: top; } 51% { transform-origin: bottom; } 100% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; } }

  /* About */
  .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: start; }
  .about-text p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
  .stat {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 30px 24px;
    transition: transform .3s var(--ease), border-color .3s;
  }
  .stat:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--accent); }
  .stat .num { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 2.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
  .stat .num em { font-style: normal; color: var(--glow); }
  .stat p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; }

  /* Expertise */
  .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-top: 56px; }
  .card {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 36px 30px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform .35s var(--ease), border-color .35s;
  }
  .card::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .4s;
    background: radial-gradient(400px circle at var(--x, 50%) var(--y, 0%), rgba(168,85,247,.18), transparent 40%);
  }
  .card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: rgba(168,85,247,.5); }
  .card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
  .card .icon {
    width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 22px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,.3), rgba(34,211,238,.15)); font-size: 1.4rem;
  }
  .card h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }

  /* Works */
  .filters { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 30px; }
  .filter {
    padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-size: .9rem; transition: .25s;
  }
  .filter.active, .filter:hover { background: var(--violet); border-color: var(--violet); color: #fff; }
  .work-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-top: 36px; }
  .work {
    aspect-ratio: 4/3; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--card); border: 1px dashed rgba(192,132,252,.3);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 24px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    transition: transform .35s var(--ease), border-color .35s;
  }
  .work::before {
    content: "▶"; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1rem;
    background: rgba(124,58,237,.25); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: .35s var(--ease);
  }
  .work:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--accent); }
  .work:hover::before { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12); background: var(--violet); }
  .work .tag { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .work h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; }
  .work .soon { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; margin-top: 4px; }
  .work[hidden] { display: none; }

  /* Case studies */
  .cases { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-top: 56px; }
  .case {
    padding: 30px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--card), rgba(18,18,28,.4));
    transition: transform .3s var(--ease), border-color .3s;
  }
  .case:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--glow); }
  .case .num-label { font-family: 'Space Grotesk'; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .case h3 { margin: 12px 0 10px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .case p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem; }
  .case .soon-pill { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; font-size: .75rem; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--orange); }

  /* Why me */
  .why { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; }
  .why-list { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
  .why-list li {
    padding: 22px 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; transition: transform .3s var(--ease);
  }
  .why-list li:hover { transform: translateX(8px); }
  .why-list .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), var(--cyan)); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .why-list strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .why-list span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }

  /* Contact */
  .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: start; }
  .contact-info a.big { font-family: 'Space Grotesk'; font-size: 1.3rem; display: inline-block; margin: 8px 0 22px; transition: color .2s; word-break: break-all; }
  .contact-info a.big:hover { color: var(--accent); }
  .contact-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; margin-top: 30px; }
  .social { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .social a { padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); transition: .25s; }
  .social a:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  form { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 22px; padding: 36px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
  .field { position: relative; }
  .field input, .field textarea {
    width: 100%; padding: 16px; background: rgba(11,11,18,.6); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s;
  }
  .field textarea { min-height: 140px; resize: vertical; }
  .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--glow); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(168,85,247,.15); }
  .field label {
    position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; color: var(--muted); pointer-events: none; transition: .25s var(--ease); font-size: .95rem;
  }
  .field input:focus + label, .field input:not(:placeholder-shown) + label,
  .field textarea:focus + label, .field textarea:not(:placeholder-shown) + label {
    top: -9px; left: 12px; font-size: .75rem; padding: 0 6px; background: var(--card); color: var(--accent);
  }
  .field .error { color: var(--red); font-size: .8rem; margin-top: 6px; display: none; }
  .field.invalid .error { display: block; }
  .field.invalid input, .field.invalid textarea { border-color: var(--red); }
  .form-status { font-size: .95rem; display: none; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; }
  .form-status.show { display: block; animation: fadeUp .5s var(--ease); }
  .form-status.ok { background: rgba(37,211,102,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(37,211,102,.35); color: #bbf7d0; }
  .form-status.err { background: rgba(244,63,94,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(244,63,94,.35); color: #fecdd3; }
  .wa-reveal {
    display: none; padding: 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(34,211,238,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.3);
  }
  .wa-reveal.show { display: block; animation: fadeUp .6s var(--ease); }
  .wa-reveal p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }

  footer { padding: 40px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; }
  .foot-inner { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; }

  /* Reveal animations */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); transition: opacity .9s var(--ease), transform .9s var(--ease); }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  .reveal.d1 { transition-delay: .1s; }
  .reveal.d2 { transition-delay: .2s; }
  .reveal.d3 { transition-delay: .3s; }
  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

  .progress { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; height: 3px; width: 0; z-index: 200; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--violet), var(--cyan), var(--orange)); }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    .hero-grid, .about-grid, .why, .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 50px; }
    .hero-visual { order: -1; }
    .portrait-wrap { width: min(340px, 80%); }
    .chip-1 { left: 0; } .chip-2 { right: 0; }
    .cards, .cases { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .work-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    section { padding: 80px 0; }
    .menu-btn { display: block; }
    .nav-links {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(11,11,18,.97); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 30px;
      transform: translateY(-100%); transition: transform .5s var(--ease); height: 100vh; height: 100dvh;
    }
    .nav-links.open { transform: none; }
    .nav-links a { font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .cards, .cases, .work-grid, .stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .cta .btn { flex: 1; justify-content: center; }
    form { padding: 26px; }
    .float-chip { display: none; }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }

  /* Social icons: preserve existing pill styling */
  .social a, .wa-reveal .btn-wa { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
  .social-icon { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* VPCR8ION combined concept preview: cinematic split intro and premium typography */
.vp-intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif}
.vp-intro__panel{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:50%;background:#11101B;will-change:transform}
.vp-intro__panel--left{left:0;border-right:1px solid rgba(192,132,252,.2)}
.vp-intro__panel--right{right:0;background:#100F19}
.vp-intro__center{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;text-align:center}
.vp-intro__mask{overflow:hidden;padding:12px 10px}
.vp-intro__logo{font:600 clamp(19px,3.3vw,40px)/1.2 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.055em;transform:translate3d(0,130%,0);white-space:normal;text-align:center;max-width:94vw;will-change:transform}
.vp-intro__logo span{color:#C084FC}
.vp-intro__name{font:700 clamp(38px,8vw,100px)/1.05 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.065em;color:#F8FAFC;opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);text-align:center;max-width:96vw}
.vp-intro__name span{font-weight:500;color:#C084FC;letter-spacing:.12em}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__name{animation:vpTextIn .7s .12s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both,vpLineOut .4s 2.05s ease forwards}
.vp-intro__rule{height:1px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#A855F7,transparent)}
.vp-intro__line{font:600 clamp(9px,1.3vw,12px)/1.7 'Inter',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.19em;color:#C9BCD8;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);max-width:90vw}
.vp-intro__skip,.vp-demo-replay{position:fixed;z-index:1010;border:1px solid rgba(192,132,252,.4);background:#211832;color:#F8FAFC;border-radius:999px;font:600 12px Inter,sans-serif;padding:12px 18px;cursor:pointer}
.vp-intro__skip{bottom:25px;right:25px}.vp-demo-replay{bottom:20px;right:20px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0007}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__logo{animation:vpLogoIn 1.05s .22s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both,vpLogoOut .6s 2.18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__rule{animation:vpRule .8s .78s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both,vpLineOut .4s 2.06s ease forwards}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__line{animation:vpTextIn .7s .93s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both,vpLineOut .4s 2.05s ease forwards}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__panel--left{animation:vpLeft 1.15s 2.47s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards}
.vp-intro.is-playing .vp-intro__panel--right{animation:vpRight 1.15s 2.47s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards}
@keyframes vpLogoIn{to{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}}@keyframes vpLogoOut{to{transform:translate3d(0,-125%,0)}}
@keyframes vpRule{to{width:min(420px,72vw)}}@keyframes vpTextIn{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes vpLineOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes vpLeft{to{transform:translate3d(-102%,0,0)}}@keyframes vpRight{to{transform:translate3d(102%,0,0)}}
/* Existing hero elements reveal with more deliberate, premium stagger. */
.hero .eyebrow.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;letter-spacing:.18em}
.hero h1.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText 1s .1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.hero .tagline.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText 1s .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both,shimmer 8s linear infinite}
.hero .skills-line.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText 1s .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.hero .cta.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText 1s .42s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.hero .exp-badge.reveal.in{animation:vpHeroText 1s .52s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.hero .hero-visual.reveal.in{animation:vpPortraitIn 1.2s .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
@keyframes vpHeroText{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,24px,0)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}}
@keyframes vpPortraitIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,28px,0) scale(.975)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vp-intro{display:none!important}.vp-intro__skip{display:none!important}.hero .reveal.in{animation:none!important}}


/* Premium animated name + responsive interactive cursor treatment. */
.vp-intro__name{overflow:visible;isolation:isolate;padding:10px 18px;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 18px rgba(124,58,237,.14))}
.vp-intro__nameText{display:inline-block!important;font:700 clamp(38px,8vw,100px)/1.08 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:-.065em!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#fff 8%,#e6d3ff 26%,#b783f8 43%,#fff 54%,#9e68f5 76%,#f9f5ff 94%);background-size:230% 100%;background-position:100% center;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(168,85,247,.16));animation:vpNameIridescent 4s 0.38s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes vpNameIridescent{0%{background-position:100% center;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(168,85,247,.12))}100%{background-position:0% center;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(168,85,247,.35))}}
.vp-intro__center{transform:translate3d(calc(var(--intro-px,0px)*.25),calc(var(--intro-py,0px)*.25),0);transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.vp-intro__nameText{transform:translate3d(var(--intro-px,0px),var(--intro-py,0px),0);transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.logo{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif!important;font-size:1.02rem!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.085em!important;transition:filter .35s ease,transform .35s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.logo span{color:var(--accent)!important}
.logo:hover{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 13px rgba(168,85,247,.55));transform:translateY(-1px)}
/* Static DOM spotlight layers use gradients; lightweight transform-only cursor follower. */
#vpCursorGlow{position:fixed;z-index:900;left:0;top:0;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-500px,-500px,0);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(168,85,247,.12),rgba(124,58,237,.055) 36%,transparent 70%);mix-blend-mode:screen;transition:opacity .4s ease;will-change:transform}
body.vp-cursor-on #vpCursorGlow{opacity:1}
.card,.stat,.case,.work,.why-list li,.social a,.btn,.portrait-wrap{--vp-x:50%;--vp-y:50%}
.card,.stat,.case,.work,.why-list li{isolation:isolate}
.card::after,.stat::after,.case::after,.work::after,.why-list li::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease;background:radial-gradient(260px circle at var(--vp-x) var(--vp-y),rgba(168,85,247,.13),transparent 70%);z-index:0}
.stat,.why-list li{position:relative}
.card:hover::after,.stat:hover::after,.case:hover::after,.work:hover::after,.why-list li:hover::after{opacity:1}
.card>* ,.stat>*,.case>*,.work>*,.why-list li>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero .eyebrow,.section-title,.hero h1,.tagline{transition:filter .3s ease}
.hero .eyebrow:hover,.section-title:hover,.hero h1:hover,.tagline:hover{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px rgba(192,132,252,.28))}
.btn,.social a,.filter,.nav-links a{transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,color .3s ease,background .3s ease}
.btn:hover,.social a:hover,.filter:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(124,58,237,.18)}
@media(hover:none),(pointer:coarse){#vpCursorGlow{display:none}.vp-intro__center,.vp-intro__nameText{transform:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vp-intro__nameText{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.vp-intro__center{transition:none!important}#vpCursorGlow{display:none!important}.card::after,.stat::after,.case::after,.work::after,.why-list li::after{transition:none!important}}


/* Interactive portrait skill constellation: playful, still readable. */
.hero-visual{isolation:isolate;padding:20px 36px;overflow:visible}
.hero-visual .vp-skill-pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;min-width:165px;max-width:210px;border-radius:16px;
 background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(31,24,50,.94),rgba(15,13,29,.92));border:1px solid rgba(192,132,252,.38);
 box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 0 25px rgba(124,58,237,.13);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
 -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);color:var(--text);cursor:default;
 animation:vpBadgeFloat 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--badge-delay);will-change:transform;
 transition:border-color .25s ease,background .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;pointer-events:auto}
.hero-visual .vp-skill-pill:hover{animation-play-state:paused;border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.75);background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(54,30,86,.97),rgba(21,18,42,.96));box-shadow:0 13px 40px rgba(124,58,237,.28),0 0 22px rgba(34,211,238,.12)}
.vp-skill-pill .vp-skill-emoji{font-size:22px;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(168,85,247,.42))}
.vp-skill-pill strong,.vp-skill-pill small{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.vp-skill-pill strong{font-size:12px;line-height:1.32;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.012em}
.vp-skill-pill small{font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;color:#cab9df;margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:.015em}
.vp-skill-pill i{position:absolute;right:8px;top:8px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#22D3EE;box-shadow:0 0 9px #22D3EE;animation:vpTwinkle 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--badge-delay)}
.hero-visual .chip-1{top:5%;left:-4%}.hero-visual .chip-2{top:24%;right:-11%;bottom:auto;left:auto}
.hero-visual .chip-3{bottom:28%;left:-10%}.hero-visual .chip-4{bottom:5%;right:-6%}
@keyframes vpBadgeFloat{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-1deg)}50%{transform:translate3d(0,-11px,0) rotate(1deg)}}
@keyframes vpTwinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.75)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2)}}
/* Clearly visible responsive custom mouse follower: halo plus crisp orbiting point. */
#vpCursorGlow{z-index:1002!important;width:240px!important;height:240px!important;
 background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(168,85,247,.16) 0,rgba(124,58,237,.09) 25%,transparent 68%)!important;mix-blend-mode:screen!important}
#vpCursorRing{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:30px;height:30px;border:1.5px solid rgba(207,174,255,.95);border-radius:50%;
 box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(124,58,237,.08),0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,.44);z-index:1003;pointer-events:none;
 transform:translate3d(-200px,-200px,0);opacity:0;transition:width .23s,height .23s,border-color .23s,background .23s,opacity .2s;will-change:transform}
#vpCursorRing span{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#F4E8FF;box-shadow:0 0 10px #C084FC;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
body.vp-cursor-on #vpCursorRing{opacity:1}
body.vp-hovering #vpCursorRing{width:46px;height:46px;border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.92);background:rgba(124,58,237,.09)}
body.vp-clicking #vpCursorRing{width:19px;height:19px;background:rgba(168,85,247,.3)}
@media(max-width:1050px){.hero-visual .chip-2{right:-4%}.hero-visual .chip-3{left:-4%}}
@media(max-width:720px){.hero-visual{padding:14px 26px 65px}.hero-visual .vp-skill-pill{display:flex!important;padding:7px 9px;min-width:0;max-width:155px;gap:6px;border-radius:12px}
 .vp-skill-pill .vp-skill-emoji{font-size:16px}.vp-skill-pill strong{font-size:10px}.vp-skill-pill small{font-size:8px}
 .hero-visual .chip-1{top:4%;left:-3%}.hero-visual .chip-2{top:25%;right:-4%}
 .hero-visual .chip-3{bottom:24%;left:-4%}.hero-visual .chip-4{bottom:7%;right:-3%}}
@media(hover:none),(pointer:coarse){#vpCursorRing,#vpCursorGlow{display:none!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hero-visual .vp-skill-pill,.vp-skill-pill i{animation:none!important}}


.vp-intro[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Scoped hanging logos, avoiding collision with existing .logo, .card or .reveal styles */
.vp-hang-section{padding:38px 0 45px!important;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 10%,rgba(75,27,114,.12),transparent 55%)}
.vp-hang-container{max-width:1030px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 25px 30px}
.vp-hang-section .story{min-height:375px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(208,165,255,.13)}
.vp-hang-section .story.reverse .copy{order:2}.vp-hang-section .story.reverse .visual{order:1}
.vp-hang-section .index{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#b38ada}
.vp-hang-section .statement{max-width:440px;font-size:clamp(21px,2.8vw,32px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.48;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:17px 0;color:#f9f2ff}
.vp-hang-section .visual{width:100%;display:grid;place-items:center}
.vp-hang-section .hanging{display:block;width:min(100%,400px);height:auto;overflow:visible;touch-action:none}
.vp-hang-section .hanger{transform-origin:0 0;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
.vp-hang-section .cable,.vp-hang-section .cableBack,.vp-hang-section .cableGlow,.vp-hang-section .cableHighlight{pointer-events:none}
.vp-hang-section .img-panel{fill:#130d1c;opacity:.55}
.vp-hang-section .img-outline{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.18);stroke-width:1.2}
.vp-hang-section .soft-label{letter-spacing:.02em}
.vp-hang-hint{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#ad94c1;padding:24px 0 0;letter-spacing:.17em}
@media(max-width:650px){.vp-hang-container{padding:8px 17px 20px}.vp-hang-section .story{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-height:0;padding:24px 0 12px}.vp-hang-section .story.reverse .copy,.vp-hang-section .story.reverse .visual{order:initial}.vp-hang-section .statement{font-size:23px;margin:9px 0}.vp-hang-section .visual{max-width:340px}.vp-hang-section .index{font-size:10px}}

</style>
</head>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="container hero-grid">

    <div class="hero-visual reveal d2">
      <div class="portrait-wrap" id="portrait">
        <img src="data:image/webp;base64,
